item.title: 一词一讲：pitch
item.description:
内容简介

单词 “pitch” 可以作名词表示足球等运动的 “球场”。不过，它还有不少其他含义，比如，“pitch an idea” 可以表示 “推介一个想法”，而声音的 “高低” 也可以用 “pitch” 来表示。你知道 “pitch” 还有哪些含义吗？看视频，跟主持人 Georgie 学习单词 “pitch” 的四个含义和用法。

用法总结

1. pitch（名词）：运动场地，球场

  • The crowd cheered when the players ran onto the pitch.
  • The pitch was flooded, so they had to cancel the match.

2. pitch（动词）：向…推介（想法、方案等）
    pitch（名词）：推介，提案

  • She pitched her business idea to the investors. Her pitch impressed them.
  • We've spent ages brainstorming the new project, now we have to pitch our ideas to the managers.

3. pitch（名词）：音高

  • Young children's voices have a higher pitch than adults' voices.
  • Dogs can hear sounds at a higher pitch than humans.

4. pitch（动词）：搭（帐篷）
    pitch（名词）：搭帐篷的地点；营位

  • We pitched our tent in the shade. Our pitch is just over there.
  • Let's pitch the tent before it starts raining. I've already found a good pitch.

item.title: 一词一讲：extra
item.description:
内容简介

想掌握单词 “extra” 的更多地道用法吗？主持人 Becca 来为你讲解 “extra” 的多种常见含义。比如，它不但可以指报刊的 “号外，增刊”，还可以用来表示影视剧拍摄时的 “群众演员，临时演员”。一起来看视频，学习单词 “extra” 的更多地道含义和用法。

用法总结

1. extra time（名词）：（体育比赛的）加时，加时赛

  • I'm so glad we went into extra time. It gave our team a few moments to score.
  • The team suffered a dramatic loss when their opponent scored the winning point during extra time.

2. extra（名词）：（报纸或杂志的）号外，增刊

  • Because of the extreme weather, the city's newspaper rushed out an extra to warn local residents.
  • Have you heard the big story in the magazine? It's all over this week's extra!

3. extra（名词）：群众演员，临时演员

  • I know I'm only an extra, but being on TV is a huge deal for me.
  • He started as an extra on the show, but his acting was so unique that they wanted him as a regular character.

4. extra（形容词）：过于夸张的，过于戏剧化的

  • Why did he shoo the waiter away? He was being so extra.
  • She hired a live band and fire dancers for her birthday. She's so extra!

item.title: 一词一讲：roll
item.description:
内容简介

单词 “roll” 可以作名词，表示 “小圆面包，小餐包”。在短语 “on a roll” 中，它还可以表示 “接连取得成功”。此外，我们也可以用 “camera roll” 来表示 “手机或其它电子设备中的 “相册”。在作动词时，“roll” 除了表示 “滚动” 这个动作之外，还能表达哪些含义呢？看视频，跟主持人 Phil 学习单词 “roll” 的四个常见含义和用法。

用法总结

1. camera roll（名词）：手机相册，电子相簿

  • I've got the most incredible camera roll after my holiday. Look at all these pictures.
  • Remember to back up the camera roll before you send out your phone for repair.

2. roll（名词）：小圆面包，小餐包

  • I only had a cheese roll for lunch. I'm starving now!
  • Can you buy some rolls and ham on your way home? I want to make stuffed rolls for breakfast tomorrow.

3. roll（动词）：（口语）开始行动；出发

  • Is that the time? OK, let's roll! We don't want to be late.
  • Looks like we're all ready now. Shall we roll?

4. on a roll（短语）：接连取得成功；状态火热，势头正旺

  • Another answer right? You're on a roll today!
  • I've ticked off five items on my to-do list already – I'm on a roll!

item.title: 一词一讲：beat
item.description:
内容简介

“Beat” 最常见的意思是 “击败，战胜” 对手。不过，你知道它还可以用来表示 “（音乐的）节拍，拍子”，或者指 “化好的整个妆容” 吗？看视频，跟主持人一起在一分钟内学习单词 “beat” 的四个常见含义和用法。

用法总结

1. beat（名词）：（音乐的）节拍，拍子

  • The concert was so fun, everyone was clapping to the beat.
  • I love that song. It has such a catchy beat.

2. beat（动词）：搅打，搅拌

  • You don't need a whisk, you can beat the eggs with a fork.
  • First, we need to beat the butter, then add the sugar.

3. beat（名词，俚语）：妆容，化好的整个妆容

  • Wow, her beat is flawless.
  • I wish I could do my make-up like her. Her beat is perfect.

4. beat（形容词）：极度疲劳，疲惫

  • He's falling asleep at his desk again. He must be beat.
  • Urgh, I've had such a long day. I'm beat.

item.title: 一词一讲：burn
item.description:
内容简介

单词 “burn” 有 “燃烧” 的意思，也可以表示像燃烧一样 “消耗” 或 “用掉” 某物。它还有一些与 “受伤、伤害” 相关的引申含义。比如，“be burned” 可以表示 “因为不愉快的经历而受挫、气馁”；名词 “burn” 则可以指 “机智而尖刻的挖苦话”。此外，在搭配 “have money to burn” 中，“to burn” 表示某物 “多得用不完”。看视频，跟主持人 Phil 学习单词 “burn” 的四个地道含义和用法。

用法总结

1. burn（动词）：因不愉快的经历而受挫、气馁

  • I'm not starting another business. I've been burned before.
  • I'm not going to that interview without preparing. I've been burnt before by doing that.

2. burn（名词，非正式）：机智而尖刻的挖苦话，犀利的嘲讽

  • She said 'here's a torch, you don't need to get dressed in the dark, you know.' He was stung by the burn.
  • I've heard what the other team said about us. What a burn! Let's prove them wrong in the next match.

3. burn（动词）：燃烧、消耗（能量等）；用掉

  • This workout is the quickest way to burn some calories.
  • How did we burn through the milk so quickly? I will have to buy another jug tomorrow.

4. (have money to) burn（动词）：多得用不完，绰绰有余

  • Nothing's too expensive for her. She's got money to burn!
  • Remember that we don't have resources to burn, so please don't waste any budget on this project.

item.title: 一词一讲：tank
item.description:
内容简介

养鱼养虾的 “鱼缸，水箱” 可以是 “tank”；汽车的 “油箱” 也可以叫 “tank”。不过，你知道夏天穿的 “背心，无袖上衣” 在英语里也被称为 “tank top” 吗？不仅如此，“tank” 还可以作动词使用。看视频，跟主持人 Phil 一起学习单词 “tank” 在英语中的四个常见含义和用法。

用法总结

1. tank（名词）：（作为计量单位）一箱油，一箱油的油量

  • It's a long drive, it'll take two tanks.
  • We still have half a tank of petrol left, so we don't need to stop at the next service station.

2. tank top（名词）：背心，无袖上衣

  • Are you trying to show off your muscles with that ridiculous tank top?
  • If the weather gets hotter, I will have to wear a tank top to work!

3. tank（动词）：彻底失败，惨淡收场

  • That wasn't the right product. Our profits have tanked since we launched it.
  • The project tanked because we weren't well-prepared. We need to plan ahead next time.

4. tank（动词）：故意输掉比赛

  • What are you doing, are you trying to tank the match?
  • The football team tanked their last match in order to avoid meeting the reigning champion in the knockout stage.

item.title: 一词一讲：swipe
item.description:
内容简介

“刷手机” 时在屏幕上用手指 “滑动，往下刷” 的动作，在英语里可以称为 “swipe”。但动词 “swipe” 的意思远不止于此。它还可以表示 “刷卡”、“挥动手臂或物体击打”，甚至还能表示 “偷窃、顺手偷走”。看视频，跟主持人 Becca 学习单词 “swipe” 的四个常见含义和用法。

用法总结

1. swipe（动词）：（用手指）滑动（屏幕）

  • You should swipe through some reviews before buying that.
  • Swipe up, and you should see the final amount to pay at the bottom.

2. swipe（动词）：刷（卡）

  • If you'd like to swipe your card when you're ready, please.
  • The card reader won't accept this card. Maybe you should try swiping a different card?

3. swipe（动词）：猛打，挥击

  • She swiped her jaw in the boxing match, and now she's even struggling to drink water.
  • Be careful! You almost swiped me with your broom!

4. swipe（动词）：偷窃，盗窃

  • I had my phone in my pocket a moment ago. I think someone swiped it!
  • He has to buy a new pair of headphones for work because the last one was swiped by someone on the train.

item.title: 一词一讲：lift
item.description:
内容简介

单词 “lift” 作动词时有 “举起，抬起” 的意思。不过，它还可以作名词使用。比如，“give someone a lift” 既可以表示 “开车顺路捎某人一程”，也可以用来表示 “鼓舞某人，让某人心情好起来”。除此之外，“lift” 还有哪些含义呢？看视频，跟主持人 Georgie 一起学习单词 “lift” 的四个常见含义和用法。

用法总结：

1. lift（动词）：举起，抬起

  • He lifted the boxes so he could move them inside.
  • She likes to lift weights to get stronger.

2. lift（名词，英式英语）：电梯，直梯

  • I'm too tired to take the stairs. Shall we take the lift?
  • The apartment is on the 8th floor, but luckily the building has a lift.

3. lift（名词）：鼓舞，振奋

  • I was feeling a bit sad, but that song really gave me a lift.
  • When I feel low, I find that spending time in nature gives me a lift.

4. lift（名词）：便车，顺路捎一程

  • Could you give me a lift to the station? It's too far to walk.
  • There were no school buses when I was a child, so my dad always gave me a lift.

item.title: 一词一讲：label
item.description:
内容简介

给商品贴 “label（标签，价签）” 是生产和销售过程中必不可少的一环；不过，给一个人 “label（贴标签、下定论）” 却未必是尊重对方的做法。看视频，跟主持人 Becca 一起学习单词 “label” 还有哪些常见的地道用法。

用法总结

1. label（名词）：标签

  • I always check the labels of food in the supermarket.
  • Can you read the nutrition label on that cereal box? I'd like to know how many calories are in a serving.

2. label（动词）：给…贴标签，对…下定论

  • You shouldn't label people just because of their style. They could wear dark clothes and have a bright personality.
  • He labels himself as a team player, which I don't think he is because he hardly listens to other people's advice.

3. label（名词）：公司，品牌商品

  • My favourite band just signed a contract with a famous record label. I'm so proud of them.
  • They used to be a major record label, but now they only have a handful of musicians.

4. label（名词）：轴标，坐标轴标签

  • The label on the x axis is the number of people shopping with us, and the label on the y axis is time, in months, over this past year.
  • I think we should change the labels on this graph, the current ones are not accurate.

item.title: 一词一讲：block
item.description:
内容简介

单词 “block” 不只有 “一块” 这个含义，还可以指一些在形状或给人感觉上像 “一大块” 的事物，比如 “街区” 或 “障碍，阻碍”，甚至 “思维上的瓶颈”。“Block” 还可以作动词，意思是 “堵塞、阻碍”。随着互联网的发展，它又衍生出了 “屏蔽（消息）” 和 “将某人拉入黑名单” 等含义。看视频，跟主持人 Phil 一起学习单词 “block” 的常见含义和用法。

用法总结：

1. block（名词）：街区，由街道围成的区域

  • We can walk. It's only two blocks away.
  • I live on a quiet block that has some green space and some trees.

2. block（名词）：障碍，阻碍；思维瓶颈

  • I've got writer's block. I don't know what to write.
  • I've hit a block with this painting. I can't quite work out which colour to paint the sky.

3. block（动词）：堵塞，阻碍

  • We can't go that way. The road's blocked!
  • Can you see the screen from your seat? A pillar is blocking my view.

4. block（动词）：屏蔽（消息），拉黑

  • If they keep bothering you, just block them.
  • I accidently blocked my parents on social media. Now they are asking if I'm OK.

item.title: 一词一讲：spring
item.description:
内容简介

你可能知道单词 “spring” 是一个名词，意思是 “春天”。不过，你知道它还有 “泉” 和 “弹簧” 的意思，而且还能作动词使用吗？看视频，跟主持人 Georgie 一起学习单词 “spring” 的四个常见含义及其用法。

用法总结

1. spring（动词）：跳，跃，蹦

  • The cat springs onto the platform.
  • When he realised he was late, he sprang out of his chair to get ready.

2. spring（名词）：弹簧

  • This bed is uncomfortable because you can really feel the springs in the mattress.
  • The trampoline has springs to make it bouncy.

3. spring（动词）：源于，产生于

  • Many of their problems spring from a lack of communication.
  • New questions sprang in his mind while reading the updated report.

4. spring（名词）：泉

  • Spring water has lots of minerals, but to drink it, you have to make sure it's safe.
  • My hands were sticky, so I found a spring to wash them in.
